description: 3B (ฟีม 2026-08-02): the fe mascot proxy (pages/api/bazi/mascot/[ganzhi].ts) must render the v2 set ONLY — read bazi `imageUrlV2` EXCLUSIVELY and NEVER fall back to the legacy `imageUrl`. The silent bug this guards: a `imageUrlV2 || imageUrl` fallback would let the OLD mascot (image_url, which on prod still points at the paused DEV storage wvcsrsjnkxikngnlwfwn — see bazi Phase 0) leak into v2 for any row that has the old image but not the new one — exactly what ฟีม forbids (v2 = ชุดใหม่เท่านั้น). A row with no imageUrlV2 must HIDE the card (rule 4, no fabricated fallback). Pure `mascotFromBaziResponse(data, ganzhi)`: imageUrlV2 present → mascot{imageUrl:=imageUrlV2}; absent/''/whitespace/null OR only-legacy-imageUrl → {mascot:null}. Teeth-proven (scripts/compat-mascot-proxy.test.ts, tsx+assert, neg-control-first): clean 9/9 (incl. 'both present → uses V2 not legacy' + 'ONLY legacy → null'); MUTANT re-add the fallback `imageUrlV2?.trim() || imageUrl?.trim()` → the 'ONLY legacy imageUrl → null' assertion trips (9→8, returns the OLD url) CAUGHT; restore → 9/9. Visual proven @393 (harness/capture-compat-3b.ts) with the mascot half rendered end-to-end through the REAL bazi prod endpoint (BAZI_BASE_URL=bazi-sft-dataset.vercel.app, verified returning imageUrlV2) → real prod storage (mootech-v2/mascot/01_wood.png): mascot renders in μุน's hero slot (3C) AND an unknown ganzhi (404) hides cleanly (no empty box). get-detail is fixture-injected (BE/matching side, out of 3B scope — not a full-chain claim); the legacy-only-no-v2 hide branch is unit+mutant proven (prod has no such row). gate_layer=data/pure (proxy mapping) + visual/rendered (hero render + rule-4 hide). NO pages/matching, NO constants/api/api-user-matching (git diff 0). Only the proxy mapping changed — CompatMascotCard/CompatResultHero/useCompatibilityResult untouched (they already render mascot.imageUrl).
